Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished high-fidelity MOBILE APP UI concept board for the existing Chinese personal life management product "AIO Life". Landscape 3:2 image with EXACTLY TWO separate portrait mobile app screens side by side, equal width and height, each about 390x844 logical pixels. Show screens straight-on, flat screenshot presentation, thin rounded outer edge, no physical phones, no perspective. Light neutral backdrop with small board title at top and generous narrow gutters. Crisp readable Simplified Chinese, professional native mobile typography, coherent line icons, excellent alignment. Realistic compact UI rather than giant airy dashboard cards; minimal borders, subtle fills, modest rounded corners. White/light-gray theme and restrained blue accent unless specified dark. Chinese labels MUST be accurate. UI data is fictional illustration.
ALL screens have an identical bottom navigation with EXACTLY FIVE equal items in this exact order: house icon "今日", clock icon "时迹", checkbox icon "任务", four-square icon "生活", person icon "我的". Keep this navigation fully visible above home indicator, no sixth item and NO central plus tab. Active tab blue, others gray. Use icon-only controls for search, settings, plus, notifications, edit. Minimum comfortable thumb targets, understated separators. No marketing illustrations, no gradients, no explanatory callout arrows, no browser chrome, no admin sidebar. Screen headings bold black, body dark-gray, muted metadata. Product identity understated.
Board title: "AIO Life · 今日与时迹".
LEFT screen: active "今日". Statusbar 9:41. Header "今日" with small "9月27日 周日" and bell icon. A compact pale-blue in-progress time card labeled "正在进行", task "阅读《人类简史》", large tabular "00:32:18", small round pause icon and square stop icon. Next a row of 3 compact metrics: "专注" / "3小时20分", "待办" / "2 / 5", "运动" / "30分钟". Then "今日待办" section, two unchecked rows "完成移动端方案" and "整理本周笔记", one muted checked row "晨间跑步". Next "常用" heading with edit icon, FOUR user-selected shortcuts in one row: "阅读", "运动", "财务", "衣柜". Next short "时间分配" blue/sage/orange horizontal stacked bar with concise legend "工作  阅读  运动". Small blue floating "+" above navigation at bottom right; leave uncluttered space around it.
RIGHT screen: active "时迹". Header "时迹", calendar icon and chart icon. Compact date row left/right chevrons and "9月27日 周日". Small metrics "已记录 6小时10分" and "专注 3小时20分". A clean vertical chronological timeline with times on left: "09:00" record "晨间阅读" / "阅读 · 45分钟"; "10:00" "移动端方案设计" / "工作 · 2小时"; "12:30" "午间散步" / "运动 · 30分钟"; "14:00" "阅读《人类简史》" / "阅读 · 进行中" highlighted subtly. Bottom above navigation, a compact live timer strip "00:32:18" with pause and stop icon buttons. Single small plus icon in header near title if room, no floating extra obstruction. All content fitted, no overflowing text.
